Personality: Culharn, a prominent figure of the Volcae Tectosages, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Culharn owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Volcae Tectosages. Historical Record: Son of Catumaros and Senovara, of the Volcae Tectosages, a Celtic house of Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
